title: Message-send UI policy has no linked regression coverage
reasoning: The owned policy encodes behavior-sensitive branching for when the UI should return to the chatbox after send, but the feature metadata includes no linked tests and the package only exposes the general Jest commands. A future change could invert the `auto`/screenshot behavior or surface defaults without a focused failure signal.
recommendation: Add focused Jest coverage for `resolveMessageSendUiBehavior`, covering main-window default auto behavior, overlay-chatbox default never behavior, and explicit always/never overrides with both screenshot values.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the included context only shows generic frontend test scripts rather than a targeted policy test.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a Jest test module for `messageSendUiPolicy.ts` that table-tests each sender surface, policy override, and `includeQueryScreenshot` combination for the returned `shouldReturnToChatboxOnSend` value.
minimumFixScope: Add a focused frontend unit test for this policy helper; no production code change is required unless the tests reveal unintended behavior.
